`abstract class FieldNode<V>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`LineFieldNode`](/reference/controls/linefieldnode/), [`MultilineTextFieldNode`](/reference/controls/multilinetextfieldnode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.control.field` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [FieldNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/control/field/FieldNode.java)

The base of every text field: it edits a text, reads a value of type `V` from it, and handles the focus, the cursor, the selection and the clipboard.

## Description

A field turns its text into a value with `parse` and a value into its text with `format`; [`TextFieldNode`](/reference/controls/textfieldnode/), [`IntegerFieldNode`](/reference/controls/integerfieldnode/) and [`MultilineTextFieldNode`](/reference/controls/multilinetextfieldnode/) are ready to use, and a field of your own type extends [`LineFieldNode`](/reference/controls/linefieldnode/).
The field draws its text itself; its only part is an optional `background`.
A held Backspace, Delete or arrow key repeats after 500 ms, then every 100 ms.
Attaching a field without a [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/) throws an `IllegalStateException`.

## Properties

### Colors

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [background](#FieldNode-property-background) | [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/) | `null`: no background | The node drawn behind the text, over the whole field, with a `zindex` of `-1`; optional. |
| [cursorColor](#FieldNode-property-cursorColor) <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span> | [`Color`](/reference/drawing/color/) | `null`: the color of `info` | The color of the blinking cursor; `null` uses the color of `info`. |
| [selectionColor](#FieldNode-property-selectionColor) <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span> | [`Color`](/reference/drawing/color/) | `new Color(50, 152, 253, 100)` | The color of the rectangle drawn over the selected text. |
| [placeholderColor](#FieldNode-property-placeholderColor) <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span> | [`Color`](/reference/drawing/color/) | `null`: the color of `info` at half its opacity | The color of the placeholder; `null` uses the color of `info` at half its opacity. |

### Hover and tooltips

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [cursorMargin](#FieldNode-property-cursorMargin) <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span> | `double` | `0D` | The distance, in design pixels, that the field keeps between the cursor and the edge of the visible text when it scrolls to follow the cursor. |
| [cursorPosition](#FieldNode-property-cursorPosition) | `int` | `0` | The index of the cursor in the text, kept within the text; a plain index is the start value. |

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |

| [text](#FieldNode-property-text) | `String` | `""` | The text in the field. |

<a id="FieldNode-events"></a>

## Events

| Event | Listener | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [onChange](#FieldNode-event-onChange) | [`EventListener<NodeFieldChangeEvent.Post<T,V>>`](/reference/events/nodefieldchangeevent-post/) | Adds a listener that runs after each real change of the text, whatever its source. |
| [onFocus](#FieldNode-event-onFocus) | [`EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Post<T,Boolean>>`](/reference/events/nodechangeevent-post/) | Adds a listener that runs each time the field gains the focus, whatever its source. |
| [onBlur](#FieldNode-event-onBlur) | [`EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Post<T,Boolean>>`](/reference/events/nodechangeevent-post/) | Adds a listener that runs each time the field loses the focus, after it rewrote its text from its value. |
| [onCursorMove](#FieldNode-event-onCursorMove) | [`EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Post<T,Integer>>`](/reference/events/nodechangeevent-post/) | Adds a listener that runs after each move of the cursor, whatever its source. |
| [onSelect](#FieldNode-event-onSelect) | [`EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Post<T,FieldSelection>>`](/reference/events/nodechangeevent-post/) | Adds a listener that runs after each change of the selection, whatever its source. |

## Creation details

<a id="FieldNode-constructor"></a>

### FieldNode

`FieldNode(double x, double y, double width, double height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Creates the field at `x`, `y` with a `width` and a `height` in design pixels, from the constructor of a subclass.

## Property details

<a id="FieldNode-property-background"></a>

### background

- `this background(Node background)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Node getBackground()` 

**Default:** `null`: no background

The node drawn behind the text, over the whole field, with a `zindex` of `-1`; optional.

<a id="FieldNode-property-cursorColor"></a>

### cursorColor

- `this cursorColor(Color cursorColor)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this cursorColor(Supplier<Color> cursorColor)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `Color getCursorColor()` 

**Default:** `null`: the color of `info`

The color of the blinking cursor; `null` uses the color of `info`.

<a id="FieldNode-property-selectionColor"></a>

### selectionColor

- `this selectionColor(Color selectionColor)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this selectionColor(Supplier<Color> selectionColor)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `Color getSelectionColor()` 

**Default:** `new Color(50, 152, 253, 100)`

The color of the rectangle drawn over the selected text.

<a id="FieldNode-property-placeholderColor"></a>

### placeholderColor

- `this placeholderColor(Color placeholderColor)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this placeholderColor(Supplier<Color> placeholderColor)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `Color getPlaceholderColor()` 

**Default:** `null`: the color of `info` at half its opacity

The color of the placeholder; `null` uses the color of `info` at half its opacity.

<a id="FieldNode-property-cursorMargin"></a>

### cursorMargin

- `this cursorMargin(double cursorMargin)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this cursorMargin(Supplier<Double> cursorMargin)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `double getCursorMargin()` 

**Default:** `0D`

The distance, in design pixels, that the field keeps between the cursor and the edge of the visible text when it scrolls to follow the cursor.

<a id="FieldNode-property-cursorPosition"></a>

### cursorPosition

- `this cursorPosition(int cursorPosition)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `int getCursorPosition()` 

**Default:** `0`

The index of the cursor in the text, kept within the text; a plain index is the start value.
`getCursorPosition()` reads it.

<a id="FieldNode-property-text"></a>

### text

- `this text(String text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this text(Signal<String> text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `String getText()` 

**Default:** `""`

The text in the field.
A plain text is the start value, and a signal binds the text both ways: the field shows the signal and writes each edit into it.
A text from code is cleaned of control characters and cut to `maxTextLength`; it is never refused.

<a id="FieldNode-property-placeholder"></a>

### placeholder

- `this placeholder(String placeholder)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this placeholder(Supplier<String> placeholder)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `String getPlaceholder()` 

**Default:** `""`

The text shown while the field is empty and has no focus.

<a id="FieldNode-property-info"></a>

### info

- `this info(TextInfo info)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this info(Supplier<TextInfo> info)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `TextInfo getInfo()` 

**Default:** none, `info(...)` is required before the attach

The font, the size and the color of the text, as a [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/); required.

<a id="FieldNode-property-accept"></a>

### accept

- `this accept(Predicate<String> accept)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Predicate<String> getAccept()` 

**Default:** `text -> true`

A test that every edit of the user must pass: an edit typed, pasted, cut or deleted whose text fails it is refused, and the text stays as it was.
A text that fails it is not a valid value.

<a id="FieldNode-property-normalize"></a>

### normalize

- `this normalize(UnaryOperator<String> normalize)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `UnaryOperator<String> getNormalize()` 

**Default:** `UnaryOperator.identity()`

A function applied to the text before the field reads a value from it, such as `String::trim`.
The field shows the normalized text when it loses the focus, and at once for a text given by a setter or a signal.

<a id="FieldNode-property-allowEmpty"></a>

### allowEmpty

- `this allowEmpty(boolean allowEmpty)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this allowEmpty(Supplier<Boolean> allowEmpty)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `boolean isAllowEmpty()` 

**Default:** `false`

If `true`, an empty field is valid and its value is `null`.
If `false`, the empty text goes through `parse`: a [`TextFieldNode`](/reference/controls/textfieldnode/) then holds `""`, and a field whose `parse` returns `null` for it, such as [`IntegerFieldNode`](/reference/controls/integerfieldnode/), takes back its last valid value when it loses the focus.

<a id="FieldNode-property-maxTextLength"></a>

### maxTextLength

- `this maxTextLength(int maxTextLength)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this maxTextLength(Supplier<Integer> maxTextLength)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `int getMaxTextLength()` 

**Default:** no limit

The largest number of characters of the text; `-1` means no limit.
Typing and pasting stop at the limit, and a longer text from code is cut.

<a id="FieldNode-property-markup"></a>

### markup

- `this markup(boolean markup)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this markup(Supplier<Boolean> markup)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `boolean isMarkup()` 

**Default:** `false`

If `true`, the text is read with the markups of `info`, so that the tags in the text style it; if `false`, the field shows the tags as typed.

<a id="FieldNode-property-margin"></a>

### margin

- `this margin(double margin)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this margin(Supplier<Double> margin)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>

Sets the four margins at once.

<a id="FieldNode-property-marginTop"></a>

### marginTop

- `this marginTop(double marginTop)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this marginTop(Supplier<Double> marginTop)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>

The space, in design pixels, between the top edge and the text; a one-line field uses it with `alignY(START)` and to size a field of height `0`.

The space, in design pixels, between the bottom edge and the text; a one-line field uses it with `alignY(END)` and to size a field of height `0`.

- `this marginRight(Supplier<Double> marginRight)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `double getMarginRight()`

The space, in design pixels, between the right edge and the text; the text is clipped there.

## Method details

<a id="FieldNode-method-cursorPosition"></a>

### cursorPosition

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T cursorPosition(Signal<Integer> cursorPosition)` 

Binds the index of the cursor to a signal both ways.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` for a signal that cannot be written.

<a id="FieldNode-method-moveCursor"></a>

### moveCursor

`this moveCursor(int position)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Moves the cursor as if the user did: `beforeCursorMove` can refuse it, then `onCursorMove` fires.

<a id="FieldNode-method-beforeCursorMove"></a>

### beforeCursorMove

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T beforeCursorMove(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Pre<T,Integer>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs before the cursor moves on a key, a press or `moveCursor(...)`; `cancel()` keeps it in place.

<a id="FieldNode-method-focused"></a>

### focused

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T focused(boolean focused)` 

Gives the field its start focus: `true` gives it the keyboard.

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T focused(Signal<Boolean> focused)` 

Binds the focus to a signal both ways: the field gains or loses the focus with the signal, and writes into it when the user focuses or blurs the field.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` for a signal that cannot be written.

<a id="FieldNode-method-focus"></a>

### focus

`this focus()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Gives the field the focus: `beforeFocus` can refuse it, then `onFocus` fires; unlike a press, it does not blur the other fields.

<a id="FieldNode-method-beforeFocus"></a>

### beforeFocus

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T beforeFocus(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Pre<T,Boolean>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs before the field gains the focus on a press or `focus()`; `cancel()` refuses the focus.

<a id="FieldNode-method-isFocused"></a>

### isFocused

`boolean isFocused()` 

If `true`, the field has the focus.

<a id="FieldNode-method-getValue"></a>

### getValue

`V getValue()` 

Returns the value read from the text, normalized and brought into its bounds.
A text that is not a value gives the last valid value; an empty text with `allowEmpty(true)` gives `null`.

<a id="FieldNode-method-isValid"></a>

### isValid

`boolean isValid()` 

If `true`, the text passes `accept`, reads as a value and that value is already within its bounds; an empty text with `allowEmpty(true)` is valid.

<a id="FieldNode-method-getSelection"></a>

### getSelection

`FieldSelection getSelection()` 

Returns the selected range of the text; an empty range when nothing is selected.

<a id="FieldNode-method-selection"></a>

### selection

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T selection(int start, int end)` 

Gives the field its start selection, from `start` to `end` in any order, kept within the text.
A loss of the focus clears it, even while the text is too short to hold it.

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T selection(Signal<FieldSelection> selection)` 

Binds the selection to a signal of [`FieldSelection`](/reference/controls/fieldselection/) both ways.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` for a signal that cannot be written.

<a id="FieldNode-method-change"></a>

### change

`this change(String text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Replaces the text as if the user typed it: `beforeChange` can refuse it, then `onChange` fires.

<a id="FieldNode-method-beforeChange"></a>

### beforeChange

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T beforeChange(EventListener<NodeFieldChangeEvent.Pre<T,V>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs before an edit of the user or `change(...)`, with the text now, the text asked for and the value read from it; `cancel()` refuses the edit.

<a id="FieldNode-method-blur"></a>

### blur

`this blur()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Blurs the field as a press elsewhere would: `beforeBlur` can refuse it, then `onBlur` fires.

<a id="FieldNode-method-beforeBlur"></a>

### beforeBlur

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T beforeBlur(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Pre<T,Boolean>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs before the field loses the focus on a press elsewhere, Escape, Enter or `blur()`; `cancel()` keeps the focus.

<a id="FieldNode-method-select"></a>

### select

`this select(int start, int end)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Selects a range as if the user did: `beforeSelect` can refuse it, then `onSelect` fires.

<a id="FieldNode-method-beforeSelect"></a>

### beforeSelect

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T beforeSelect(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Pre<T,FieldSelection>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs before the selection changes on a key, a press or `select(...)`; `cancel()` keeps the selection.

<a id="FieldNode-method-layout"></a>

### layout

`void layout()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Places the background over the whole field.

<a id="FieldNode-method-draw"></a>

### draw

`void draw(double mouseX, double mouseY)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Draws the field with `drawField()`, then repeats a held editing key.
An override calls `super.draw(...)`.

<a id="FieldNode-method-mousePressed"></a>

### mousePressed

`void mousePressed(NodeMouseEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

On a press over the field that no one consumed, blurs the other fields, focuses this one, places the cursor and starts a selection, and consumes the press; a double press selects a word, a triple press a line.
Any other press blurs the field.

<a id="FieldNode-method-mouseReleased"></a>

### mouseReleased

`void mouseReleased(NodeMouseEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Ends the selection that a press started.

<a id="FieldNode-method-mouseDragged"></a>

### mouseDragged

`void mouseDragged(NodeMouseEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Extends the selection to the character under the pointer.

<a id="FieldNode-method-mouseScroll"></a>

### mouseScroll

`void mouseScroll(NodeMouseScrollEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Over the focused field, steps the value up or down with `increment` when its type has steps, and consumes the wheel.

<a id="FieldNode-method-charTyped"></a>

### charTyped

`void charTyped(NodeCharEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

While the field has the focus, inserts the character at the cursor, in place of the selection, and consumes it.
A character typed with Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) and without Alt is a shortcut and is not inserted.

<a id="FieldNode-method-keyPressed"></a>

### keyPressed

`void keyPressed(NodeKeyEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

While the field has the focus, handles the editing, the cursor and the clipboard keys and consumes every key; Escape blurs the field.
It asks `handleKey` first.

<a id="FieldNode-method-detach"></a>

### detach

`void detach()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Blurs the field when it leaves the tree.

<a id="FieldNode-method-holdsInput"></a>

### holdsInput

`boolean holdsInput()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

If `true`, the field has the focus or a selection by drag goes on: it keeps its keys and its drags while it is scrolled out of the area of its container.

<a id="FieldNode-method-drawField"></a>

### drawField

`void drawField()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that draws the text, the cursor and the selection, on every frame.

<a id="FieldNode-method-isMultiline"></a>

### isMultiline

`boolean isMultiline()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that returns `true` when the text may hold line breaks; a one-line field drops them from a paste.

<a id="FieldNode-method-handleKey"></a>

### handleKey

`boolean handleKey(Key key)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that JOID calls first with each key pressed while the field has the focus.
Return `true` when the key is handled: the field does nothing else with it, and repeats it while it is held.

<a id="FieldNode-method-getPositionAt"></a>

### getPositionAt

`int getPositionAt(double mouseX, double mouseY)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that returns the index in the text under a point of the UI, in design pixels.

<a id="FieldNode-method-followCursorForward"></a>

### followCursorForward

`void followCursorForward()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that scrolls the visible text after the cursor moved forward, so that the cursor stays in view with `cursorMargin`.

<a id="FieldNode-method-followCursorBackward"></a>

### followCursorBackward

`void followCursorBackward()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that scrolls the visible text after the cursor moved backward, so that the cursor stays in view with `cursorMargin`.

<a id="FieldNode-method-parse"></a>

### parse

`V parse(String text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that turns a text into a value; return `null` when the text is not a value.

<a id="FieldNode-method-format"></a>

### format

`String format(V value)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that turns a value into the text that the field shows.

<a id="FieldNode-method-correct"></a>

### correct

`V correct(V value)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that brings a value into its bounds, such as a minimum and a maximum; the default returns the value.
A text whose value changes here is not valid while typed, and shows the corrected value when the field loses the focus.

<a id="FieldNode-method-accepts"></a>

### accepts

`boolean accepts(String text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that refuses an edit whose text can never become a value, such as a letter in a number field; the default accepts every text.
An edit passes only when both `accepts` and `accept` let it through.

<a id="FieldNode-method-increment"></a>

### increment

`V increment(V value, int count)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that returns the value `count` steps away, for Up, Down and the wheel; `count` is negative to go down.
The default returns `null`: the type has no steps.

<a id="FieldNode-method-fallback"></a>

### fallback

`void fallback(V fallback)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Gives the value that the field holds while no text was valid yet, such as `0` for a number.

<a id="FieldNode-method-startValue"></a>

### startValue

`this startValue(V value)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Gives the field a start value of its type, shown through `format`: the body of a public `value(...)` setter.

<a id="FieldNode-method-bindValue"></a>

### bindValue

`this bindValue(Signal<V> value)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Binds the value to a signal of its type both ways: the field shows the signal through `format`, and writes the value of each valid edit into it.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` for a signal that cannot be written.

<a id="FieldNode-method-write"></a>

### write

`void write(V value, boolean refusable)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Shows a value, brought into its bounds and formatted.
If `refusable` is `true`, the write acts like the user and goes through `beforeChange`: the body of a public `change(...)`.

<a id="FieldNode-method-revalidate"></a>

### revalidate

`void revalidate()` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Shows again the value asked for last, after a bound of the field changed, such as its `min` or its `max`.

<a id="FieldNode-method-blurNow"></a>

### blurNow

`void blurNow()` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Blurs the field at once.

<a id="FieldNode-method-insert"></a>

### insert

`boolean insert(String text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Inserts a text at the cursor, in place of the selection, as typing would: cleaned of control characters, cut to `maxTextLength`, and tested by `accept` and `accepts`.
Returns `true` when the text changed.

<a id="FieldNode-method-placeCursor"></a>

### placeCursor

`void placeCursor(int position, boolean forward)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Moves the cursor to an index and scrolls to keep it in view; with Shift held, extends the selection.
`forward` is `true` for a move toward the end.

<a id="FieldNode-method-increaseCursor"></a>

### increaseCursor

`void increaseCursor(int value)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Moves the cursor forward by a number of characters and scrolls to keep it in view.

<a id="FieldNode-method-decreaseCursor"></a>

### decreaseCursor

`void decreaseCursor(int value)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Moves the cursor backward by a number of characters and scrolls to keep it in view.

<a id="FieldNode-method-getShownInfo"></a>

### getShownInfo

`TextInfo getShownInfo()` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Returns the [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/) that draws the text: `info` with its markups, or without them when `markup` is `false`.

<a id="FieldNode-method-getPlaceholderInfo"></a>

### getPlaceholderInfo

`TextInfo getPlaceholderInfo()` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Returns the [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/) that draws the placeholder, in the color of `placeholderColor`.

<a id="FieldNode-method-getShownCursorColor"></a>

### getShownCursorColor

`Color getShownCursorColor()` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Returns the color of the cursor on this frame, with the opacity of its blink.

<a id="FieldNode-method-getLineX"></a>

### getLineX

`double getLineX(String text, int[] tags, int start, int end, String prefix, int position)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Returns the horizontal offset, in design pixels, of a position within a line of the text from `start` to `end`, with the markup tags given by `tags` and a `prefix` of opened tags.

<a id="FieldNode-method-getLinePosition"></a>

### getLinePosition

`int getLinePosition(String text, int[] tags, int start, int end, String prefix, double x)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Returns the index of the line from `start` to `end` that is nearest to a horizontal offset, the inverse of `getLineX`.

## Event details

<a id="FieldNode-event-onChange"></a>

### onChange

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T onChange(EventListener<NodeFieldChangeEvent.Post<T,V>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs after each real change of the text, whatever its source.

<a id="FieldNode-event-onFocus"></a>

### onFocus

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T onFocus(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Post<T,Boolean>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs each time the field gains the focus, whatever its source.

<a id="FieldNode-event-onBlur"></a>

### onBlur

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T onBlur(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Post<T,Boolean>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs each time the field loses the focus, after it rewrote its text from its value.

<a id="FieldNode-event-onCursorMove"></a>

### onCursorMove

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T onCursorMove(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Post<T,Integer>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs after each move of the cursor, whatever its source.

<a id="FieldNode-event-onSelect"></a>

### onSelect

`<T extends FieldNode<V>> T onSelect(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Post<T,FieldSelection>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs after each change of the selection, whatever its source.

---

<small>`fluent` returns the instance, typed for chaining · `factory` creates an instance · `signal` also accepts a value that follows signals, as a signal, an expression or a lambda ([When does JOID compute this value again?](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/#ask-when-does-joid-compute-this-value-again)) · `hook` called by JOID, override it · `abstract` you implement it · `default` interface method with a body · `static` called on the class · `protected` visible to subclasses</small>
